title: PlatformCapabilities
description: What the desktop host knows about the computer and build it runs on (M33). Written by the host, never by the worker. Carries no paths, user names or hardware identifiers.

version.description: Marketing version such as 15.2, or null when the host does not read it (Windows reports it in the system check).

minimum.description: Oldest release this build supports, or null when no floor is enforced.

binary.description: CPU architecture the host executable was built for.

translated.description: True when the executable runs under translation (Rosetta 2); null when unknown.

target.description: Rust target triple of the host.

bundled_worker.description: Whether this build looks for a worker inside the application bundle.

level.description: alpha: a supported alpha target; development: works but is not a supported release; unsupported: this build should not be used here.

directories.title: PlatformDirectories
directories.description: Which convention application data follows. The paths themselves are never reported.

secret_store.description: Where persistent secrets would be kept. Nothing persists a secret yet.

signing.title: PlatformSigning
signing.description: M38: how the running application is signed, as the host checked it with the operating system's own code-signing and Gatekeeper tools. Only the classification is reported: never the signer's name, team, certificate or any path. Absent in documents written before 1.28.

state.description: not-applicable: not checked on this OS. unknown: the check could not run or timed out. unsigned: no signature. adhoc: signed without an identity (development and CI builds). developer-id: signed with a Developer ID but not notarized. notarized: Developer ID signed and accepted by Gatekeeper as notarized. other: any other signing identity.

hardened_runtime.description: Whether the executable carries the Hardened Runtime flag; null when not checked or unknown.
